overall_conclusion: All 10 high-res visual sets have informative genus/species-group characters, but none isolates the critical keyed character or performs authenticated specimen dissection. Species-level signoff and merge remain blocked.

records.visible_at_1024px: The spike is visibly slender, cylindrical and divided into repeating jointed segments. Long projecting awns and individual spikelet units are much clearer at 1024-pixel source resolution.
records.unresolved_key_characters: No detached mature segment with floret count, actual glume dimensions and measurements; the visible joint pattern supports goatgrass but does not prove a complete species diagnosis.
records.precise_next_proof: Detach one whole internode + spikelet unit, show two glumes and florets with mm scale.

records.visible_at_1024px: Overlapping pointed spikelets and branching structure are sharp and plainly visible; the pale glumes appear translucent. Some leaf/seedhead structures can be inspected against a fingertip.
records.unresolved_key_characters: A second glume isolated flat with clear 3–7 vein count and precise 6–8 mm length remains absent; species separation from existing T. mutica unproven.
records.precise_next_proof: Flatten a mature second glume on contrasting background; illuminate the veins, measure to 0.5 mm, photograph blade width.

records.visible_at_1024px: Several long awned panicle branches, wet-edge setting, broad leaves, and leaf-sheath/collar hairs are evident in linked images.
records.unresolved_key_characters: The papilla-based origin of sheath hairs and measured glume/lemma/awn attachment are not resolved; possible Echinochloa relatives remain.
records.precise_next_proof: Oblique macro of sheath hairs at bases, then detach a ripe spikelet beside millimeter rule.

records.visible_at_1024px: Field and close images show erect narrow, dense tan flowering heads and an accessible sheath/leaf junction.
records.unresolved_key_characters: An isolated broad blunt upper glume, 2–3-floret count, and 1.5–3 mm membranous ligule are not sufficiently resolved.
records.precise_next_proof: Isolate a spikelet showing the second glume face and blunt tip, plus scaled inner ligule.

records.visible_at_1024px: Repeated, conspicuously jointed cylindrical raceme axis and regularly inset rounded spikelet structures are distinct, compared against fingertips.
records.unresolved_key_characters: An actual exposed sessile fertile spikelet niche, pitted glume and pedicellate sterile spikelet are not separately displayed.
records.precise_next_proof: Remove one rachis joint and photograph pit and sessile/pedicellate pair at about 5×–10× with mm scale.

records.visible_at_1024px: Individual imbricate spikelets in paired rows can be seen on close racemes; one observation depicts detached mature spikelets on a palm, while another displays branched flowering heads.
records.unresolved_key_characters: The small lower glume presence and length, papillose-based hairs and pubescence on upper glume and sterile lemma are not independently visible/measurable even at 1024 px. Three separate TEX sheet scans were viewed and likewise cannot resolve these microcharacters.
records.precise_next_proof: Take 10×–20× photos of both spikelet faces from a verified Hays sample; isolate first glume and short papillose-based hairs; compare P. pubiflorum.

records.visible_at_1024px: Compact, pale to pinkish dense panicle portions and culm habit are clear; some photos show mature closely overlapping florets.
records.unresolved_key_characters: The deeply cleft lemma apex and thin papery glume texture/veins are not visible on an isolated floret.
records.precise_next_proof: Separate a mature lemma, photograph a split/cleft apex with a millimeter rule and compare Tridens flavus.

records.visible_at_1024px: Many conspicuous slender, silky awn-like bristles extend from pinkish spikelets, and the dry prairie/bunchgrass habit is well documented.
records.unresolved_key_characters: There is no isolated mature lemma with a reproducible count of 11–15 appendages or measured body; similarly feathery relatives remain possible.
records.precise_next_proof: Dissect one fully ripe lemma; fan out all appendages under scope and count with 1-mm scale.

records.visible_at_1024px: A large somewhat swollen purplish culm node is very clear; broad leaves, panicle architecture and numerous darkening spikelets are also sharp in one eight-photo observation.
records.unresolved_key_characters: The lower/upper glume proportion and lower floret reproductive parts cannot be measured; no rhizome section proves perennial spread or planted/escaped status.
records.precise_next_proof: Photograph detached mature florets from this specimen, both glumes, and roots/rhizome system; reconcile with older Panicum antidotale key.

records.visible_at_1024px: Excellent comparably scaled images show hairy/ciliate fingerlike racemes, a collar/ligule hair tuft and detached spikelet/awn structures against a metric ruler.
records.unresolved_key_characters: Floret number, fertile versus sterile lemma and awn arrangement still need formal comparison with S. ciliata; apparent macro clarity is not yet an accepted species determination.
records.precise_next_proof: Measure fertile and sterile florets on the shown loose spikelets, and compare to independently verified S. ciliata at identical scale.
